# Journal reasons

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m uske.outcomes`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every journal line carries a state and, often, a reason. A state is one of the four
outcomes `uske` writes (`direct-placement`, `transformation-required`, `quarantine`,
`inconclusive`), or a state a person writes by hand to record a decision `uske` did
not take (`placed-by-exception`, `abandoned`). A reopening is also written by hand,
under `inconclusive` (reason `uske/reopened`).

Under `inconclusive`, nothing is placed, as for a refusal, but nothing is decided
either: the image is not refused, and the next screening judges it again.

**Read the state and the reason as a pair**: the same reason does not say the same
thing under two states. `<...>` marks a part filled in when the line is written;
`<provider>/<criterion>` is a playbook rule.

| Reason | State | What it says | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<provider>/<criterion>` | `quarantine`, `transformation-required` | The first critical rule of the playbook that failed. It is the first cause, not the only one: the report lists them all. | Read the rule in the report, and its definition in the `regis` rules reference (`docs/reference/rules`). |
| `<provider>/<criterion>` | `inconclusive` | A critical rule did not finish: a tool failed, or some data was missing. Nothing is decided about the image (D-23). | Read in the report why the rule is `incomplete`. The next screening judges it again. |
| `uske/better-tier-missed:<provider>/<criterion>` | `inconclusive` | No critical rule failed, but this non-critical rule did not finish: the image may have missed a better tier. An evaluation that does not conclude decides nothing (D-23). | Read in the report why the rule is `incomplete`. The image may be sound; the next screening judges it again. |
| `regis/exit-1` | `inconclusive` | `regis` failed technically, after Argo's retries. This is not a verdict on the image. | Read the logs of the workflow's `regis` step. |
| `regis/exit-3` | `inconclusive` | The call to `regis` was malformed: the metadata does not satisfy a schema the playbook declares. This is not a verdict on the image. | Fix the playbook or the metadata; the report lists the failing fields. |
| `regis/exit-<N>` | `inconclusive` | `regis` stopped on another code (2: command line rejected). | Read the logs of the workflow's `regis` step. |
| `regis/no-report` | `inconclusive` | `regis` left no readable report. | Read the logs of the `regis` step, then check the work volume. |
| `regis/no-verdict` | `inconclusive` | The report holds no playbook result. | Check that the workflow passes a playbook to `regis`. |
| `regis/unknown-tier` | `inconclusive` | The tier returned is none of those `uske` knows. They are named as the playbooks write them: `Placement direct`, `Transformation requise puis placement`, `Quarantaine`. | Align the playbook's tier names with this list. |
| `uske/unknown-track` | `inconclusive` | The policy names a track with no known playbook: the image was not evaluated (D-21). | Add the playbook for this track, or fix the policy's track. |
| `uske/remediation-refused` | `quarantine` | Closing line on the source: its remediated image was judged and refused. One attempt per source; this is not a new verdict on the source (SDR-0016). | The line's `rebuilt` key is the digest of the refused image: `uske decisions` on the source shows that image's line and report. To try again, reopen the source: append a `uske/reopened` line by hand, as [`docs/explanation/how-it-works.md`](../explanation/how-it-works.md#rebuilds-and-repairs) shows. |
| `uske/rebuild-refused` | `quarantine` | Older closing line, written before remediation on order: the source's rebuilt image was judged and refused (SDR-0016). New lines say `uske/remediation-refused`. | The line's `rebuilt` key is the digest of the refused image: `uske decisions` on the source shows that image's line and report. To try again, reopen the source, as [`docs/explanation/how-it-works.md`](../explanation/how-it-works.md#rebuilds-and-repairs) shows. |
| `uske/remediation-undeclared` | `quarantine` | The track made the source repairable, but the policy's import declares no `remediate:` step: `knock` held the operation back. | Declare `remediate:` in the policy, then reopen the source ([`docs/explanation/how-it-works.md`](../explanation/how-it-works.md#rebuilds-and-repairs)); or remove the rule from the track's repairable list. |
| `uske/no-transit` | `inconclusive` | The source needed remediation, but no transit was configured to hold the remediated image until its verdict: the operation was withdrawn. The screening's copies were placed. | Name the workflow's transit. The next screening judges the source again. |
| `uske/reopened` | `inconclusive` | Line written by hand: someone reopened the source (SDR-0016), as [`docs/explanation/how-it-works.md`](../explanation/how-it-works.md#rebuilds-and-repairs) shows. | Nothing: the next screening judges it again. |
| *(none)* | `direct-placement`, `transformation-required` | No reason. Under `transformation-required`, the tier comes from a playbook condition that names no failed critical rule. | Nothing for a direct placement; otherwise, read the report. |
